title: Erdős Problem 357: Lean formalization, verification scripts and computations
description:
Lean 4 formalization, verification scripts and computations for the paper Bounds for increasing sequences with distinct consecutive sums (Erdős Problem 357) by Chandler Snively (Quana Labs). The formalization proves f(n) ≤ (44273/90000) n + 2√n + 177792 for all n, f(n) ≥ (12/√21)√n − 48 for all n, and f(n) ≥ (15/√21)√n − 1800 for n ≥ 12096·5042, for the function f of Erdős Problem 357 as defined in the Formal Conjectures project. Exact values of f(n) for n ≤ 77 are included as computational evidence. The open question whether f(n) = o(n) is not addressed.

The results, proofs and formalization were produced by AI systems in a project directed by the author; see docs/PROVENANCE.md. They have not been checked by an independent human mathematician or peer reviewed.
